natural_edition_english.detail: Visible master, cover, setup labels, and README prose are natural English.

attribution_source_license_nonendorsemen.detail: The edition identifies Wen-Wei Li and the frozen source commit/tree, states CC BY 4.0 and modification status, disclaims endorsement by Wen-Wei Li and Higher Education Press, distinguishes the two independent bridges, and credits OpenAI Codex gpt-5.6-sol, Ultra without displacing authorship.

language_residue.detail: No active Han text occurs in the scoped TeX. Indonesian-named compatibility environments are retained only as source command identifiers and render English headings. The README's Chinese original-title field is intentional bibliographic identification, not residue.

dates_and_paths.detail: Compilation date is September 1, 2026; source-publication dates remain identified as source facts; edition-facing paths checked exist. The stale missing Zenodo-receipt pointer was replaced with an accurate pending-publication statement.

static_tex_safety.detail: All scoped TeX files have balanced unescaped braces and balanced begin/end environments. AJbook2.cls, cover/setup files, mycommand.sty, myarrows.sty, Al-jabr.bib, and ccby.png exist. No TeX engine was invoked.

license_text.detail: source/en/LICENSE identifies Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International and contains Sections 1 through 8, including the no-endorsement provision.

fixes.change: Updated the ProvidesFile declaration from the stale upstream 2018 date to 2026/09/01 and identified it as English title formatting.
Replaced a link to the nonexistent release/ZENODO_PUBLICATION_RECEIPT.json with the accurate statement that the archival DOI is pending Zenodo publication.
